::: {#exr-shift-conv}

#### Moving the input of a convolution

`shift_right()` below moves each image one pixel to the right,
filling the left column with 0.
Apply a [convolutional layer](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/cnn-rnn.html#def-convolutional-layer) to a test digit and to its shifted copy.
How does the output for the shifted copy compare with the output for the original?

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
def shift_right(images):
    # Move each image in a batch one pixel right; the left column becomes 0.
    moved = torch.zeros_like(images)
    moved[..., 1:] = images[..., :-1]
    return moved


print(x_test[0, 0, :3], shift_right(x_test[:1])[0, 0, :3], sep="\n")
```

:::
